title: Ordinary point-extension and derived Hom models
statement: For a field k, a commutative coefficient ring R, a sheaf B of commutative rings on (Spec k)_proet, and a map from the constant R-sheaf to B, construct the constant module functor, extension on objects and morphisms, sections with restricted scalars, ordinary Hom and total tensor complexes, their homogeneous elements, and the normalized comparison predicates. The exact definitions, including coefficient models and the canonical derived representative map, are those in the attached Lean declarations. These are real sheafification, scalar-extension, Hom projection, and localization constructions; this interface relocates the existing definitions without changing their data or meaning [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pur-hom-complex, lem-coef-integral-hom-reduction].
